options.scene: Living-room sofa, evening lamplight. Aachu cross-legged at one end, phone in both hands, thumb just lifted, bright expectant smile aimed at Zuv. Zuv slouched at the other end in his own phone's glow. A visible cushion-width gap between them.
options.why: The gap stages the whole story; both phones established; text proven by her expectant look toward him.

options.scene: Bed, both under lamp, she sends from her side.
options.why: Collides with slide 4's night setting; weakens the pivot's change of place/time.

options.scene: Kitchen counter, she sends while he cooks.
options.why: Cooking steals attention from the phone latency premise; busier anatomy (utensils).

options.scene: Same sofa, mid shot favoring Aachu. Her head turned toward Zuv in a first deadpan side-eye, phone dropped to her lap. Zuv mid-laugh at his own screen, head tipped back slightly, phone glow on his face.
options.why: His joy vs her flatline in one frame proves 'laughing at YOUR phone' instantly.

options.scene: Over-the-shoulder from behind Zuv showing his screen.
options.why: Requires rendered screen content — rejected failure surface.

options.scene: Aachu leaning into his field of view, waving.
options.why: Funny but escalates too early; slide 3 needs the headroom.

options.scene: Extreme close-up of Aachu's face from slightly below, full playful unblinking side-eye, one eyebrow raised, lips pressed. Zuv's oblivious soft-focus profile at the right frame edge. Minimal background wash.
options.why: Peak beat acted purely by eyes; close crop with minimal background is the identity-safest way to do an exaggerated expression — features stay reference-driven, no hands needed.

options.scene: She holds her phone screen toward his face showing the chat.
options.why: Rendered chat UI; arm-extension anatomy risk.

options.scene: Mid two-shot, her arms crossed, glaring.
options.why: Arms crossed reads angry not playful; violates affection rule and loses the camera-distance escalation.

options.scene: Same sofa, moments after slide 3. Both turned fully toward each other, each holding their own phone out face-to-face so the two screens nearly touch, identical warm glow on both faces. Aachu's glare collapsing into incredulous laughter; Zuv delighted, mid-laugh. Phone screens shown as plain glow only, no UI.
options.why: Creator-selected pivot A (same-reel twist): mirrored phones + mirrored laughter prove 'the SAME reel' visually with zero UI; symmetric composition releases the camera arc and makes slides 1-3 retroactively mutual.

options.scene: Same night under one shared blanket, ONE phone between them, both lit by its glow, watching her reels together.
options.why: Original 'save them for us' pivot — creator rejected as bland; resolves with a shrug, not a snap.

options.scene: He shows her a saved-collection folder on his phone.
options.why: Depends on rendered UI to land.

options.scene: Morning after, he reacts with hearts while she sleeps.
options.why: Sweet but breaks single-evening continuity and the 'together' pivot becomes solitary.
